What the repo does show is that the fast suite is plain pytest:

```
pytest -m "not postgres" -q
```

That's the `test-fast` target from the old Makefile. If your justfile has a matching recipe, `just --list` will show its name. It's probably `just test-fast`, but I haven't confirmed that.

There's also a possible mismatch. The only marker in `tests/` is `@pytest.mark.integration` in `tests/test_payments.py:7`, and nothing uses a `postgres` marker. So `-m "not postgres"` may not exclude anything, and `-m "not integration"` may be what you want. pytest will also warn about unregistered markers, because `pyproject.toml` doesn't register either one.
